# Codex Stream Deck

> Local macOS bridge for an Elgato Stream Deck and the Codex desktop app: local task status, selected shortcuts, and weekly usage display.

This optional reader index follows the llms.txt proposal (https://llmstxt.org/). It is a navigation aid, not a claim that crawlers, AI systems, or search engines will index, train on, rank, or recommend the project.

Codex Stream Deck is for Codex desktop on macOS with a USB Elgato Stream Deck, chiefly the 15-key MK.2. It is not an MCP server, Claude Code integration, hosted service, or unattended approval mechanism. It relies on experimental local Codex desktop formats and macOS Accessibility/Automation permission. Stream Deck + mappings have synthetic coverage only in this release; other hardware is experimental. Compatibility after Codex updates is not promised.

Related, separate project: [WhatsApp Assistant](https://github.com/ckundel2008/whatsapp-agent-mcp), a local WhatsApp MCP project by the same publisher. It is not a dependency of Codex Stream Deck.
